question: Which of the following viruses can easily cause a latent infection ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Cytomegalovirus -> Establishes latent infection in host cells -> 80% confidence. CHAIN: Parotitis -> Unlikely to cause latent infection -> 20% confidence. CHAIN: Rage -> Unclear if it can cause latent infection -> 50% confidence. CHAIN: Hepatitis A -> Does not typically cause latent infection -> 80%
analysis: Viruses that can easily cause latent infections are those that have the ability to establish a lifelong infection in the host, often remaining dormant and reactivating at a later time. Among the options provided, Cytomegalovirus is known to cause latent infections in humans.
